description: Java class implementing a LoRaWAN provider for Actility, handling message extraction and normalization.

classes.name: ActilityProvider
classes.description: A LoRaWAN provider class for Actility, implementing methods to extract and normalize message data.

methods.name: extractDeviceId
methods.description: Extracts device ID from the JSON message.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts payload data from the JSON message.

methods.name: extractMessageType
methods.description: Determines message type, returns UPLINK or UNKNOWN.

methods.name: extractNormalizedData
methods.description: Normalizes and extracts key data fields from the message into a map.

methods.name: extractAdditionalData
methods.description: Removes certain fields from the message copy for additional data extraction.
